style="rounded=1;html=0;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;" value="TAG POLICY (Attached to Root | Section 3.2 & 5)
• Enforces PascalCase keys across all pilot cloud resources
• Mandatory keys: Client, Project, Environment, Owner, CostCenter,
 FarmId, CollectionCenter, Name
• Allowed values enforced by policy:
 - Environment: dev, qa, pdn, shared (ASM-006, ASM-063)
 - CostCenter: farms, drones, collection-centers, trips, shared (ASM-064)
 - CollectionCenter: cauca, huila, tolima
• Capitalization enforced for Client, Project, Owner, FarmId, Name" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="132" width="430" x="65" y="168" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_scps" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=0;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;" value="SERVICE CONTROL POLICIES (SCPs | Attached to Root & OUs)
1. Deny leaving organization (Root: organizations:LeaveOrganization)
2. Deny non-us-east-1 Regions (Root: aws:RequestedRegion != us-east-1)
3. Protect audit trail & S3 archive (Root: deny trail/lock/kms tampering)
4. Deny long-term IAM credentials (Root: deny iam:CreateUser/Key) [ADR-003]
5. Deny member root users (Root: centralized root credential denial)
6. Require cost tags on creation (Workloads OU: aws:RequestTag)
7. Pipeline-only production changes (Production OU: deny human write in pdn)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="430" x="65" y="308" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_scp_root" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=0;fillColor=#fee2e2;strokeColor=#ef4444;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Root SCPs: 1-5 Active" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="210" x="65" y="452" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_scp_workloads" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=0;fillColor=#fef3c7;strokeColor=#d97706;fontColor=#92400e;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Workloads SCP: 6 Active" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="210" x="285" y="452" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_scp_prod" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=0;fillColor=#fee2e2;strokeColor=#dc2626;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Production SCP: 7 Active (Pipeline-Only Changes | Break-Glass Exempt)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="430" x="65" y="488" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="scp_note" parent="1" style="text;html=0;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#475569;" value="• SCPs attach to Root, Workloads OU & Production OU; evaluate before IAM

style="text;html=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="• Formula: AllocatedCost = TotalSharedCost * (ComponentOperations / TotalOperations)
• Scope: Shared managed services without native sub-resource tagging:
 - AWS IoT Core message broker and topic rule evaluations
 - Amazon Data Firehose cross-account audit ingestion stream
 - Amazon CloudWatch centralized audit log groups
• Metric: Stored operation counts per CostCenter reported to monthly billing audit
• Implementation: AWS Cost Categories map CostCenter tags to line items
• Verification: Prorating verified against consolidated billing invoices (ASM-065)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="165" width="690" x="1645" y="1620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_badges" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=0;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=1.5;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="245" width="720" x="1630" y="1805" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_badges_hdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=0;fillColor=#fef3c7;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#92400e;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" value="Architecture Catalog Traceability (docs/architecture.md Section 14)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="720" x="1630" y="1805" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_badges_text" parent="1" style="text;html=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="• [D02] S3 State Buckets: One per environment with native DynamoDB locking
 (aroma-pdn-tfstate, aroma-qa-tfstate, aroma-dev-tfstate)
• [D03] Transversal Configuration: common_tags and secrets management
• [D04] Network & VPC: Boundaries, subnets, TGW hub and VPC endpoints (pdn, qa, dev)
• [D06] Identity & KMS: Identity Center, Cognito pools, GitHub OIDC, KMS keys
• [D09] Telemetry Ingestion: IoT Core certificates, topic rules, DynamoDB store

Traceability Contract: All diagram components correspond exactly to IaC modules
in B01-B13 and architectural decisions recorded in docs/decision-log.md." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="205" width="690" x="1645" y="1840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

• Capitalization enforced for Client, Project, Owner, FarmId, Name

g.text: SERVICE CONTROL POLICIES (SCPs | Attached to Root & OUs)
3. Protect audit trail & S3 archive (Root: deny trail/lock/kms tampering)
4. Deny long-term IAM credentials (Root: deny iam:CreateUser/Key) [ADR-003]
5. Deny member root users (Root: centralized root credential denial)
6. Require cost tags on creation (Workloads OU: aws:RequestTag)
7. Pipeline-only production changes (Production OU: deny human write in pdn)

g.text: Shared Resource Usage-Based Cost Allocation Formula (ASM-065)
• Scope: Shared managed services without native sub-resource tagging:
- AWS IoT Core message broker and topic rule evaluations
- Amazon Data Firehose cross-account audit ingestion stream
- Amazon CloudWatch centralized audit log groups
• Metric: Stored operation counts per CostCenter reported to monthly billing audit
• Implementation: AWS Cost Categories map CostCenter tags to line items
• Verification: Prorating verified against consolidated billing invoices (ASM-065)

g.text: • [D02] S3 State Buckets: One per environment with native DynamoDB locking
• [D03] Transversal Configuration: common_tags and secrets management
• [D04] Network & VPC: Boundaries, subnets, TGW hub and VPC endpoints (pdn, qa, dev)
• [D06] Identity & KMS: Identity Center, Cognito pools, GitHub OIDC, KMS keys
• [D09] Telemetry Ingestion: IoT Core certificates, topic rules, DynamoDB store
Traceability Contract: All diagram components correspond exactly to IaC modules
in B01-B13 and architectural decisions recorded in docs/decision-log.md.
